name: ConfigCat
description: Manage ConfigCat feature flags: list products, configs, and environments; create, read, update, and delete feature flag settings and their values.

auth.description: Use your ConfigCat Public Management API credentials. You can find them at https://app.configcat.com/my-account/public-api-credentials

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List all products (organizations) in the ConfigCat account.

tools.name: list_configs
tools.description: List all configs (config files) within a given product.

product_id.description: The ID of the product to list configs for.

tools.name: list_feature_flags
tools.description: List all feature flag settings within a given config.

config_id.description: The ID of the config to list feature flags for.

tools.name: get_feature_flag
tools.description: Get the details of a specific feature flag setting.

setting_id.description: The numeric ID of the feature flag setting.

tools.name: create_feature_flag
tools.description: Create a new feature flag setting in a config.

config_id.description: The ID of the config to create the feature flag in.

key.description: The unique key (identifier) for the feature flag, e.g. 'my_feature_enabled'.

name.description: The human-readable name of the feature flag.

hint.description: A short description or hint for the feature flag.

setting_type.description: The type of value this feature flag holds.

setting_id.description: The numeric ID of the feature flag setting to delete.

tools.name: get_flag_value
tools.description: Get the current value and targeting rules of a feature flag for a specific environment.

setting_id.description: The numeric ID of the feature flag setting.

environment_id.description: The ID of the environment to get the feature flag value for.

tools.name: update_flag_value
tools.description: Update the value of a feature flag for a specific environment. Optionally include a reason for the change.

setting_id.description: The numeric ID of the feature flag setting.

environment_id.description: The ID of the environment to update the feature flag value in.

value.description: The new value for the feature flag (boolean, string, or number depending on the flag type).

reason.description: Optional reason for the change (used for audit logs if mandatory reason is enabled).

tools.name: list_environments
tools.description: List all environments within a given product.

product_id.description: The ID of the product to list environments for.
